scope: Zero-training same-host inference timing and static complexity audit; no confirmation data.
host: Server B (rsdr-b), one physical GPU selected after utilization snapshot below 85%; all models on same GPU.
synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after each timed call
models: ReCoVP-Hybrid with candidate selection/dictionary construction, Stage1 solve, Stage2 and end-to-end split
load_audit: Record GPU model/UUID, utilization and concurrent processes before and after; if utilization changes by >20 percentage points, label the affected method/batch measurement as interfered.
cpu: Record CPU model, thread count, Python and numerical-library versions for Max-TF and GMM-OMP.
complexity: Record parameter count; record FLOPs/MAC only when tool and counting convention are stated; list complex arithmetic and analytical solve omissions explicitly, do not estimate missing operations.
failure_handling: If a checkpoint, inference wrapper, dependency, or exact method input is unavailable, stop only that method and document the blocker. Do not replace missing methods with unrelated benchmarks or mix GPU/CPU results.
